# Moinul Islam — QA Automation, Manual & Security Tester

> Moinul Islam is a QA Automation Engineer, manual tester and security tester based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with nearly six years of experience (since 2021) testing web, mobile (Android & iOS) and API products across HRMS, fintech, healthcare, EdTech, e-commerce, logistics and transport systems. He builds test automation frameworks, runs load tests, does hands-on security and penetration testing (SQL injection, XSS, IDOR, JWT) with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap and Kali Linux, and uses AI-assisted testing with Claude Code. Open to remote roles: QA Automation, SDET, Security QA / VAPT.

## Summary

- Nearly 6 years of manual and automated testing across 11 business domains: HRMS & payroll, fintech, healthcare, EdTech, transport systems, warehouse & procurement, logistics, e-commerce & payment gateways, supply chain, email-marketing SaaS and digital advertising.
- Built a UI automation framework from scratch (Selenium WebDriver, Java, TestNG, Page Object Model) running in Jenkins CI.
- Reviewed 110+ third-party apps for the Mailchimp Partner Program.
- Security testing: SQL injection, XSS, IDOR / broken access control, JWT and session testing against the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10, using Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap and Kali Linux; has reported findings to bug bounty programmes.
- AI-assisted testing: uses Claude Code and Playwright MCP for test design, automation scripting and bug reports; built a Hermes Agent assistant bot on Telegram.
- Currently learning: ISTQB Foundation Level (CTFL), a cyber security course, and labs on TryHackMe, HackTheBox and PortSwigger Web Security Academy. Certification roadmap: eJPT, then BSCP, then OSCP.

## Skills

- Manual testing & test design: boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, state transition, exploratory testing, test plans & strategy, defect life cycle & severity/priority triage, test metrics & QA reporting (pass rate, defect density), accessibility testing (WCAG 2.1, axe), localization / multi-language testing, regression, smoke & sanity, UAT, cross-browser, Agile / Scrum
- Test automation: Selenium WebDriver, Selenium Grid, Playwright, Cypress, Appium (real & cloud devices), Katalon Studio, TestNG, JUnit, Pytest, Robot Framework, Cucumber (BDD), Page Object Model, BrowserStack, parallel & cross-browser runs, visual testing
- API & performance testing: Postman, Newman, Rest Assured, contract testing (Pact), load & stress testing with k6 and JMeter, Grafana & InfluxDB dashboards
- Security testing: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Kali Linux, OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, SQL injection, XSS, IDOR / access control, JWT, session & authentication testing, VAPT, bug bounty reporting
- AI & agents: Claude Code, Playwright MCP, AI-assisted test design, prompt engineering, Hermes Agent, Telegram bot
- Languages & databases: Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL (MySQL) for database testing & data validation, Linux (Ubuntu, Kali) command line
- CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker (containerised test runs), Git / GitHub, Maven, Gradle
- Tools: Jira, ClickUp, Bugzilla, Trello, Figma (UI validation)

## Experience

- Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation), BYSL Global Technology Group — Jan 2023 to present. Set up the QA process, built the Selenium/Java/TestNG framework on Jenkins, automated API regression (Postman/Newman, Rest Assured), led QA for the enterprise HRMS suite on web and Android (Appium), tested e-commerce, logistics and BOM products across web, iPad, iPhone and Android.
- SQA & Test Automation Engineer, Quality Up Services — Apr 2022 to Dec 2022. Reviewed 110+ Mailchimp Partner Program apps, end-to-end testing of Mailchimp mobile web and native iOS/Android apps, Python/Selenium/Pytest automation with Allure reports, API testing.
- SQA Engineer, SEBPO — Jan 2021 to Mar 2022. Cross-browser and cross-device testing of digital ad creatives, test cases from SRS and wireframes, Selenium and Katalon automation, JMeter performance testing.
